OVERVIEW                                                               概述

Year 2020 is a special year in the development of the Group. In        2020年是本集團發展歷程中特殊的一年，
the face of the outbreak arrival of the COVID-19 pandemic, the         新冠疫情突如其來，本集團共克時艱，上
Group united as one to overcome the difficulties and strived to set    下同心、銳意進取，在跨越發展之路上邁
foot on the path of leapfrog development in order to make steady       出了堅實的步伐，整體發展穩中有進，交
progress in overall development, delivering results that can endure    出了一份經得起時間檢驗的答卷。
the essence of time.

                    Fair value is the price that would be received to sell                    公允價值為於計量日期於市場參

                    technique. In estimating the fair value of an asset or a                  進行估算。估算資產或負債的公
                    liability, the Group takes into account the characteristics               允價值時，本集團會考慮市場參
                    of the asset or liability if market participants would take               與者於計量日對資產或負債定價
                    those characteristics into account when pricing the                       時所考慮之資產或負債之特點。
                    asset or liability at the measurement date. Fair value                    綜合財務報表中計量及╱或披露
                    for measurement and/or disclosure purposes in these                       的公允價值均按此基準釐定，惟

                    a basis, except for share-based payment transactions                      為基礎的支付規定範圍內的以股

                    Payment, leasing transactions that are accounted for in                   財務報告準則第16號入賬的租賃
                    accordance with HKFRS 16, and measurements that                           交易，以及與公允價值類似但並
                    have some similarities to fair value but are not fair value,              非公允價值的計量（如香港會計
                    such as net realisable value in HKAS 2 Inventories or                     準則第2號存貨中的可變現淨值

                                                                                              中的使用價值）則除外。


                    For financial instruments which are transacted at fair                    就按公允價值交易的金融工具

      27. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                             27. 資本風險管理

           The Group manages its capital to ensure that entities in             本集團管理其資本以確保本集團實體
           the Group will be able to continue as a going concern                能夠持續經營，同時通過優化債務與
           while maximising the return to shareholders through the              股本間的平衡為股東帶來最大回報。
           optimisation of the debt and equity balance. The Group’s             本集團的整體戰略由往年起保持不
           overall strategy remains unchanged from prior year.                  變。


           The capital structure of the Group consists of equity                本集團的資本結構由本集團擁有人應
           attributable to owners of the Group, comprising capital and          佔權益（包括綜合權益變動表所披露
           retained profits as disclosed in the consolidated statement of       的股本及留存利潤）組成。
           changes in equity.


           The directors of the Company review the capital structure            經計及資本成本及與各類資本相關的
           on a semi-annual basis. As part of this review, the directors        風險，本集團董事每半年檢討資本結
           consider the cost of capital and the risks associated with           構。根據本集團董事的推薦意見，本
           each class of capital. Based on recommendations of the               集團將通過派付股息、發行新股及回
           directors, the Group will balance its overall capital structure      購股份以及發行新債或贖回現有債務
           through the payment of dividends, new share issues and               以平衡其整體資本結構。
           share buy-backs as well as the issue of new debt or the
           redemption of existing debt.

33. RETIREMENT BENEFITS SCHEMES                                     33. 退休福利計劃

   The employees of the PRC subsidiaries are members of the           中國附屬公司的僱員為由中國政府運
   state-management retirement benefits scheme operated by            作受國家管理的退休福利計劃成員。
   the PRC government. The Group is required to contribute            本集團須將薪酬開支按各地方政府機
   a specified percentage of payroll costs as determined by           關制定的比例向退休福利計劃作出供
   respective local government authority to the retirement            款，以為福利提供資金。本集團有關
   benefits scheme to fund the benefits. The only obligation of       退休福利計劃的唯一責任是根據計劃
   the Group with respect to the retirement benefits scheme is        作出規定的供款。
   to make the specified contribution under the scheme.


   The Group also operates a Mandatory Provident Fund                 本集團為所有香港僱員均參與強制性
   Scheme for all employees in Hong Kong. The assets of the           公積金計劃。該計劃的資產與本集團
   scheme are held separately from those of the Group, in funds       的資產分開持有，並由獨立信託人控
   under the control of trustees. The Group contributes a certain     制的基金管理。本集團及僱員在該計
   percentage of the relevant payroll costs to the scheme, which      劃下都須按相關薪金成本若干百分比
   contribution is matched by the employees.                          供款。


   The amounts of contributions made by the Group in respect          本集團於年內就退休福利計劃作出的
   of the retirement benefit schemes during both years are            供款金額披露於附註11及12。
   disclosed in notes 11 and 12.
